summary.zh: 判断内容需求该走写作还是选题规划
summary.en: Route a content request to writing or to topic planning

description.zh: 收到“帮我做内容”这类笼统需求时，先分清是要写一篇成稿，还是要定选题、栏目和发布计划，再交给对应的做法。适合不确定该从哪一步开始时使用。它本身不产出内容，只做分流。
description.en: Takes a broad content request and decides whether it is a writing job or a planning job, then hands it to the matching workflow. Use it when it is unclear where to start. It produces no copy itself.
